changelog:
**New unified command-line interface; enhanced references and trust boundary documentation.**

- Added unified entry script (`scripts/mm.py`) supporting 9 modalities for all generation scenarios, streamlining usage.
- Introduced new reference files: capabilities, budget & privacy guidance, feature flags, quota mappings, official sources, and troubleshooting.
- Implemented official documentation verification and local reference fallback; outputs difference reports for transparency.
- Updated output directory and project isolation rules for more robust and predictable behavior.
- Strengthened user prompts: always display estimated Token Plan request usage, rolling window policy, and privacy/trust boundary before execution.
- Maintained compatibility with legacy scripts while promoting transition to the new interface.
